docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Bāṇa’s prose life of King Harṣa of Kanauj, the first historical romance of Sanskrit, in the English of Cowell and Thomas (London, 1897). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Harsa-carita of Bana · Bana, Cowell, Edward B. (Edward Byles), 1826-1903, Thomas, Frederick William, 1867-1956 · 1897, 306 scanned pages. Published 1897; Edward Byles Cowell died 1903 and Frederick William Thomas 1956; the text is of the seventh century; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
